definitions: To move from place to place.
To travel to many different places.
To avoid a problem or a rule.
To become widely known (of news or information).
To persuade someone to allow you to do something.
examples: It's easy to get around London by tube.
She gets around a lot with her job.
We need to get around this regulation.
News of their engagement soon got around.
He knows how to get around his parents.
